descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S17 「Web 重连保持加密：离线 → 在线，会话撤销 → 重新登录，刷新，两个模式」 Web reconnects stay encrypted: offline → online, session revoke → sign in again, reload, both modes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere.（UAT OAT-02；UAT 4；TFA-92568 AC 4；TFA-92568 Eng 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U2 All traffic is encrypted in transit. This includes the live-dictation audio stream and the backend's calls to the AI and email providers (Bedrock, Vertex, OpenAI, SES).（UAT OAT-02；TFA-92568 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given The deployed QA build with DevTools Network on 'Preserve log' in desktop Chrome, with a chart open. Not on and never with store-review-test-account@roundcompanion.com. Run only on the deployment Q8 names. The @roundai.test sign-in code comes from Tim running seed:issueTestOtp on that deployment.

When In Hospital and then in Nursing Home: go offline for 30 s and back online; let Tim revoke the session and sign in again; reload the tab. The phone transitions are in S19 and the dictation restarts in S21.

Then Every reconnect (Convex WebSocket, auth calls) uses wss:// or https://. Nothing falls back to ws:// or http://.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-02 step 1 across connection states. Any http: or ws: entry after a transition = Fail, quoted with the transition and the mode (3.3).

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
